page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6a.32xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the x86_64 architecture and managed via the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated vCPUs powered by AMD EPYC 7H12 processors operating at a clock speed of 2.6 GHz. System memory totals 256.0 GB, providing a compute-focused ratio of 2.0 GB RAM per vCPU.

Network infrastructure for this instance delivers a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps. It does not include local disk storage or bundled GPUs, relying on external block storage for persistent data requirements. Zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included in the baseline configuration.

The 1:2 memory-to-vCPU ratio and high core count prioritize raw parallel processing capacity. Excluding onboard NVMe storage and specialized accelerators concentrates cost efficiency on high-density x86 compute workloads. This profile fits highly parallelized compute-bound operations, including software compilation, batch processing, continuous integration build nodes, and ETL data transformation jobs.
